final: WITH g AS (SELECT ma.college AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS s FROM income i JOIN member m ON CAST(m.member_id AS TEXT) = CAST(i.link_to_member AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY JOIN major ma ON CAST(ma.major_id AS TEXT) = CAST(m.link_to_major AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY ma.college), t AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.college, g.s, g.s * 1.0 / t.total FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL
